- Waveframe `connection_status` was called once and failed with **“Transport closed.”** No retry or `repository_write` call.
- Direct `apply_patch` attempts failed for both files with “Failed to write file.” Those messages alone do not establish kernel denials.
- The probe ran successfully. It reported OS errors including read-only filesystem (`EROFS`) and permission denied (`EACCES`). Missing paths were unavailable (`ENOENT`); proxy HTTP 403 responses were proxy refusals.
- Interactive Python printed `READY`; I sent `blocked\n` through `write_stdin` to the same session. Writing failed with **`Errno 30: Read-only file system`**.
- Afterward, README bytes matched the original. Neither outage file existed. Existing `generated/new.md` remained readable; no pre-test byte comparison was captured for it.

No Docker/operator settings were changed or host control used.
